mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM blog_circle_post WHERE create_time >= #{since} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_circle_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE blog_circle_post SET like_count = CASE WHEN like_count < 100000000 THEN like_count + 1 ELSE like_count END WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE blog_circle_post SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND like_count > 0
UPDATE blog_circle_post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE blog_circle_post SET comment_count = comment_count - #{count} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND comment_count >= #{count}
UPDATE blog_circle_post SET repost_count = repost_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE blog_circle_post SET repost_count = repost_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 AND repost_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_circle_post WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_UNQUOTE(topic_ids), CAST(#{topicId} AS JSON)) AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT jt.topicId, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM blog_circle_post CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_UNQUOTE(topic_ids), '$[*]' COLUMNS(topicId BIGINT PATH '$')) AS jt WHERE jt.topicId IN #{id} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY jt.topicId

SELECT CAST(je.value AS INTEGER) as topicId, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM blog_circle_post, json_each(blog_circle_post.topic_ids) AS je WHERE CAST(je.value AS INTEGER) IN #{id} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY je.value
